input: check if a port is open
check if a port is in use
check if a port is listening
how to check if port is open

arguments.command:
termy_say -s "Please enter the port number" &&
printf "🌐 Enter port number: " &&
read -r target_port &&
if [ -n "$target_port" ]; then
 printf "
Checking port %s...

" "$target_port" &&
 if command -v ss > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  ss -lntp "sport = :$target_port";
 else
  lsof -i :"$target_port";
 fi &&
 printf "\nAnalysis for port \033[1m%s\033[22m completed.\n" "$target_port" &&
 termy_say -s "Port analysis completed";
else
 printf "⛔ Port number cannot be empty.\n" &&
 termy_say -s "Operation cancelled";
fi
arguments.explanation: Checks if a specified port is open and displays the process using it.
arguments.goal: Check port status

arguments.command:
OUTPUT_TXT=$(ss -tuln | awk 'NR>1 {split($4, a, ":");
print a[length(a)]}' | sort -nu | awk '{print "- Port: \033[1m" $1 "\033[22m"}') &&
COUNT=$(echo "$OUTPUT_TXT" | grep -c 'Port:') &&
printf "🌐 \033[1mActive Listening Ports:
\033[22m\n%s\n" "$OUTPUT_TXT" &&
termy_say -s "Found $COUNT active listening ports"
arguments.explanation: Displays a list of active listening network ports.
arguments.goal: List active listening ports
